entities.name: Alpharael
entities.description: A Monoist acolyte who loses his sister Raphaella to the Plummet, volunteers for the assault on the Dawnsire and takes sekhar.

entities.name: Raphaella
entities.description: Alpharael's identical sister, a Monoist who plummets into Sothera in an inevitor and writes final death poems.

entities.name: Haliya
entities.description: A Solar Knight squire of the Sunstar Free Company who serves Syr Vondam and questions the Sum.

entities.name: Syr Vondam
entities.description: A calm, soft-bodied Solar Knight of the Free Company, Haliya's mentor, who learns he will die in the coming battle and goes to meet it.

entities.name: Captain Slats
aliases: Coronal-Captain Dark Fringes Upon Bands of Light Through a Narrow Slot
entities.description: An Astelli being of light who is the Dawnsire's coronal-captain and phorocasts Vondam's death.

entities.name: Cataphrin
entities.description: A squire, daughter of a minor Cosmogrand, who briefs her bind on the Monoist suicide attack.

entities.name: Isidor
entities.description: A vain but gifted squire from a family of mirrorscape architects.

entities.name: Santaphor
entities.description: A squire of the bind who lectures on looking for the Sum.

entities.name: Quinidad
entities.description: A small, sharp squire, child of an aristocrat mathematician.

entities.name: Walker
entities.description: Quinidad's Solar Knight, who guards the bridge.

entities.name: Regent Maximum Taman IV
entities.description: The divine emperor of the Celestial Palatinate whose Free Company sails the Candela.

entities.name: Saint Sunsolde
entities.description: A saint of the Summists named in Raphaella's mockery.

entities.name: Immortal Faller
entities.description: The messianic figure of Monoism descending into supervoids, whose transmissions the Monoists glean.

entities.name: Dawnsire
entities.description: The Sunstar Free Company's dreadnought needle-like weapon built to survive a supervoid's firewall, a horizon javelin charging to reignite Sothera.

entities.name: Candela
entities.description: A flying-city shieldship that escorts and protects the Dawnsire.

entities.name: Inevitor
entities.description: A stealthy one-way Monoist boarding pod that plunges along a free trajectory at thirty kilometers a second.

entities.name: Sekhar
entities.description: A bead holding a microvoid that, when taken, collapses the wearer into a black hole entangled with Point Prime.

entities.name: Cherazad
entities.description: A tactical event horizon that delays the impact's momentum for about ten minutes.

entities.name: Alabile
entities.description: The tidal metal used in Monoist armor.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: The newborn supervoid at the heart of the system, which the Monoists made their thousandth.

entities.name: Susur Secundi
entities.description: The dark, obsidian Monoist world of tides, tunnels and mines, thousandth outpost of the True Faith.

entities.name: Adagia
entities.description: The world of mirrors, the Palatinate colony in Sothera.

entities.name: Point Prime
entities.description: The first Monoist supervoid to which martyrs are commended.

entities.name: Monastery Singul
entities.description: A Monoist monastery in orbit that sends Alpharael messages and blessings.

entities.name: Monoists
entities.description: Followers of the Immortal Faller who seek supervoids and prepare a suicide assault on the Dawnsire.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: The Palatinate's Summist cause-mercenaries whose knights and squires defend the Dawnsire.

entities.name: Celestial Palatinate
entities.description: The empire sponsoring the Free Company.

entities.name: Astelli
entities.description: Beings of light and quantum behavior who phorocast likely futures.

entities.name: Bright Sum
entities.description: The Summist doctrine of increasing the light and life of the cosmos through calculation, which Haliya is told to look to.

entities.name: INEVITA
entities.description: The Monoist promised future and purpose at the end of time.

entities.name: Next Eternity
entities.description: The Monoist afterlife reached by falling into a supervoid; Alpharael realizes only hell.

events.summary: In a dream, Alpharael falls into Sothera after his sister Raphaella and begs her to turn back.
events.quote: Of course we're sure, Alph. We were always going to do this.

events.summary: Raphaella is torn apart on the horizon, and Alpharael realizes there is no Next Eternity, only hell.
events.quote: There is no Next Eternity. There is only hell.

events.summary: Raphaella's final transmission explains the Monoist purpose, describes the Dawnsire and Candela, and bids farewell as her inevitor falls toward Sothera.
events.quote: that we will destroy the Dawnsire

events.summary: Alpharael wakes from the nightmare and a steward tells him his sister's inevitor completed its transit, proving that inevitors can penetrate the Free Company's defenses.
events.quote: Her flight has proven that an infalling inevitor can penetrate the Free Company's defenses.

events.summary: Alpharael says he wants to die and asks to join the next assault on the Dawnsire.
events.quote: Tell them I want to go in with the next wave,

events.summary: Alpharael parties with miners the night before the raid, unable to grieve his sister.
events.quote: Alpharael tries to get messed up enough to break down sobbing, but he can't.

events.summary: A rahu blesses the strike cadre and gives Alpharael a sekhar bead.
events.quote: The rahu gives Alpharael a microvoid trapped in a bead.

events.summary: The Monoist inevitors launch toward the Dawnsire, and Alpharael learns they will hit at thirty kilometers a second.
events.quote: We hit it at thirty kilometers a second.

events.summary: On the Candela, Haliya wraps Vondam in his himsary banners before battle and he tells her they go to the Dawnsire where there may be combat.
events.quote: We are going over to the Dawnsire today,

events.summary: Haliya recites the Litany of Dawn with Vondam and asks for breakfast with her friends.
events.quote: If it is where you want to be when you face death, Squire? Then there is time for nothing else.

events.summary: Haliya's bind discusses the expected Monoist suicide attack.
events.quote: So, they need an unreasonable way, a way that makes no sense: throw people at the problem and hope one of them manages something.

events.summary: CoroNet orders squires to report as phorocast predicts imminent enemy action.
events.quote: REPORT TO YOUR KNIGHTS. PHOROCAST PREDICTS IMMINENT ENEMY ACTION.

events.summary: Vondam and Haliya go to the Dawnsire's bridge and meet Captain Slats, an Astelli, who phorocasts that Vondam will die in the battle.
events.quote: I phorocast that you die in the battle.

events.summary: Haliya blurts that the prophecy might be an enemy trick, uttering the blasphemy anstruth.
The bridge darkens red as phorocast detects an imminent impact, and Slats orders collision alarms and the deployment of knights.
events.quote: Garrison to repel boarders, number-two basilica!

events.summary: Vondam closes his helmet and tells Haliya to look to the Sum, then goes to face the attack.

relations.quote: Why did they choose you when we are the same, identical but for our sex?
It is her duty as a squire and aspirant.
The most promising pupil Vondam has ever taught.

relations.note: old friends who tease each other
relations.quote: It's good to see you, Vondam,
Slats is an Astelli, a being of light.

relations.note: a squire of the Free Company
relations.quote: They all came to the Free Company together
Now we must protect the newborn void from those who would destroy it

relations.note: the Candela shields and escorts the Dawnsire
relations.quote: it is escorted by the Candela, a shieldship of formidable heritage and warcraft.
Monoism is a messianic death cult.
